scope: Independent source and selected-figure review of six notebooks against upstream snapshots/configurations; supplements execution logs and numerical tests, not a claim that all possible inputs are error-free.
review_findings_resolved: Restored custom-guide inner split seed to 1000; data_seed=0 is a split index, not its RNG seed.
Kept current Keras evidential class to avoid unintended L2 activation and KL-annealing offset when restoring legacy deterministic balancing.
Removed stale synthetic-example wording from custom guide.
Made single-epoch guide history points visible; exposed original heavy-tailed NIG uncertainty with labeled symmetric-log scale and count colorbars.

notebooks.evaluation_review: All test rows evaluated after both models finish. Batched eval-mode inference, physical-unit errors, exact NIG Student-t NLL/intervals/PIT, and variance decomposition. No test-based fitting or checkpoint selection.

notebooks.data: Original full mPING path retained by default; recorded run explicitly selects the unmodified upstream ptype_sample.parquet with MILES_PTYPE_DATA.

split.rule: Original quality filters, case-study days, date cutoff, then train/validation day groups

preserved.feature_scaler: Per-feature RobustScaler, groups=[] as in original notebook

required_corrections: CrossEntropyLoss consumes logits; softmax applied once for evaluation.
Evidence outputs converted to Dirichlet probabilities before probability metrics.
Device passed by keyword to avoid binding it to class weights.
Epoch summaries use actual observation counts, including final partial batches.
notebooks.evaluation_review: Complete held-out test split, separate standard and evidential metrics, fixed four-class axis, confusion, reliability/bin counts, variance traces and distinct vacuity statistic.

required_corrections: Deterministic section uses the deterministic legacy wrapper matching its MLP/MSE configuration.
Stale imports and Keras checkpoint spelling adapted.
Member-specific input and target scalers retained for ensemble reload; moments converted before combination.
Gaussian sigma squared before variance combination; exact mixture density/quantiles used for ensemble/dropout diagnostics.
notebooks.evaluation_review: Test remains outside fitting. Gaussian, Student-t, and Gaussian-mixture distributions handled separately. Deterministic dropout spread not called a complete predictive interval. Large evidential variance tail retained and shown on a labeled symmetric-log axis.

notebooks.data: Unmodified upstream data/ptype_sample.parquet, as selected by the original deterministic YAML and reused by the original evidential section.

split.rule: Original quality filters, case-study days, date cutoff, then train/validation day groups

preserved.feature_scaler: Shared train-fitted per-feature quantile preprocessing from original deterministic section

required_corrections: Legacy deterministic wrapper retains balanced minibatch generator and class weights that current API does not accept.

notebooks.evaluation_review: Full test metrics, confusion, reliability counts and variance/vacuity diagnostics; no test-based training decisions. Original balanced deterministic sampling and weights retained, not applied to the evidential model.

notebooks.execution_limit: Full pretrained BERT and real held-out data were unavailable. Default cells are guarded and report skipped scientific sections; source notebook deliberately has no fabricated outputs.

notebooks.original_reference: New adaptation guide; default anchored to original PyTorch regression notebook
notebooks.data: Default is original Cabauw sample; classification requires the user's own labeled CSV.
explicit_adaptations: User data input/output dimensions are adapted.
Random/group/time split options are for user data.
Guide demonstrates validation-NLL checkpoint selection, distinct from restored original workflows.
Classification starts from original Torch architecture and training budget; no synthetic default.
notebooks.evaluation_review: Preprocessing and vocabulary fitted on training rows, test outcomes used only after checkpoint freeze, exact NIG or categorical evaluation, saved split assignments/preprocessing/state/metadata and new-row inference.

remaining_limits: Full external mPING dataset is unavailable here; recorded Torch classification run explicitly uses the authors' bundled sample.
Original BERT notebook has no training/test dataset or trained task checkpoint; real-model scientific evaluation is not claimed.
Paper-figure, sounding, SHAP and dataset-preparation notebooks retain external data/checkpoint requirements and were not fully rerun.
Original short training budgets can give poor skill or calibration; settings were not retuned based on test results.
Native macOS/Windows, GPU and distributed execution are outside this notebook review.
